changes: Recovery certification now verifies Git ancestry in addition to timestamp ordering.
FAILURE_OBSERVED, RETRY_AUTHORIZED and pre-retry REPLAN persistence commits must be ancestors of the CI-certified implementation SHA.
For terminal success, RECOVERED must be committed as a descendant of the implementation SHA on the final task line.
A recovery journal is inspected whenever present, even when the replacement CI run has run_attempt=1.
Old-SHA GitHub reruns can no longer provide terminal v2 Recovery certification solely through apparently valid timestamps.
Project Leader and Recovery Guardian contracts now require a fresh certifying run on a descendant SHA containing the pre-retry journal.
